item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Thursday 19 February In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Thursday, 19 February - politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate Global India AI Impact Summit; World leaders, tech CEOs gather for key dialogue
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the India AI Impact Summit in Delhi, bringing together global leaders, ministers, tech CEOs, and startups to shape the future of artificial intelligence.

item.title: T20 WC 2026: IND vs SA clash to headline Super 8 stage; Set to shape India’s Semi Final hopes
item.description: India will face South Africa in a crucial Super 8 encounter of the ICC T20 World Cup at the Narendra Modi Stadium on February 22. With strong group-stage performances from both sides, the high-pressure clash could determine the semifinal trajectory.

item.title: Nifty opens above 25,850; Sensex gains amid strong global cues
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks opened higher on February 19, supported by positive global signals. The Nifty traded above 25,850 while the Sensex posted modest gains in early deals. IT stocks led the rally, whereas select financial and aviation shares faced pressure.

item.title: Gold Price: Safe-haven shine returns; Is this the moment to buy Gold?
item.description: Gold prices recorded a modest gain on February 19, with domestic futures on MCX rising slightly while international rates hovered near the $5,000 mark on Comex. IBJA benchmark prices also moved higher.

item.title: Bill Gates cancels AI Summit speech, Ankur Vora to address gathering; Full details
item.description: Tech leader Bill Gates will no longer address the AI Impact Summit, with the Gates Foundation confirming that Ankur Vora will speak instead. The high-profile event in New Delhi brings together global leaders, policymakers, and innovators to discuss artificial intelligence, partnerships, and development priorities.

item.title: Sundar Pichai announces mega AI infrastructure at India AI Impact Summit 2026; Google to invest $15B in India
item.description: At the India AI Impact Summit 2026, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai announced a $15 billion investment in India, establishing a full-stack AI hub in Visakhapatnam. The hub will feature gigawatt-scale compute and an international subsea cable gateway, bringing advanced AI infrastructure, jobs, and innovation to India.

item.title: India AI Summit 2026: PM Modi highlights youth, innovation, and global AI leadership with MANAV vision
item.description: At the India AI Impact Summit 2026, PM Narendra Modi emphasized India’s role as a global AI hub, launching the mantra “Design in India, Deliver to the World.” He highlighted youth-led AI innovation, ethical standards, and transparency in digital content.

item.title: Brazilian arrested with Rs 24 crore worth cocaine at Bengaluru airport
item.description: During examination of the checked-in baggage of the accused, officers recovered four ladies’ handbags that had been specially modified with false walls and concealed bottom compartments. The cavities were found to contain multiple pieces of clothing fabric chemically infused with cocaine

item.title: Macron urges PM Modi to ban social media for children under 15 at India AI Summit 2026
item.description: At the India AI Summit 2026, French President Emmanuel Macron urged PM Narendra Modi to ban social media for children under 15, citing France’s existing regulations.
